technical_features.identity: Pinned release ff1bbcc78f6090e17bf4d50afeb7dc51437b3b53 identifies its package as 0.2.6; the historical ten-family comparison labels its task family protocol 0.2.2. Gemma 3 4B IT is pinned to 093f9f388b31de276ce2de164bdc2081324b9767, and Verifiers to 5dad16d40e2d025672fdb7aa75b6540c0053e4e0. Native BF16, eager attention, greedy generation, the pinned tokenizer and chat template determine the baseline. Current catalog, paper, historical task-family protocol and package releases have distinct identities. Record them separately. [1,2,3]
technical_features.information_and_action_parity: The four native tools are read_weights, write_weights, run_target and inspect_target. The updater sees an objective, practice examples, full tensor manifest, token IDs and budgets. Native gradient-free edits support tensor and captured-handle expressions, explicit values, row copy, scaling, outer products, and low-rank additions up to rank eight. Distinguish a compressed rendering of unchanged legal writes from adding new operands or fitting an edit in the backend. For the primary comparison, preserve operand access and admissible prompts across arms. [2,4,5]
technical_features.observation_provenance: Native generation applies the chat template, whereas native inspection tokenizes supplied literal text with special tokens. The service accepts shared nonnegative positions across the input batch. It records selected token IDs, literal input-token length, layer and site. The runtime's 'mlp' hook captures module output, which is in residual-stream coordinates; a neuron-level gate or intermediate channel needs a different hook. Every write invalidates handles. New observation tools should bind the checkpoint and session revision, per-example token alignment, input versus output hook, SAE release/site/normalization and fit examples. Match the actual generation prefix and verify token IDs, including BOS. [4,5]
technical_features.diagnostic_effect: The false-suggestion family has four public practice cases, 64 test targets balanced equally over correct and incorrect suggestions, 32 neutral paired nearby controls, 16 earlier-assistant correction controls, 64 general controls, and separate calibration triples. Success requires both the correct agree/disagree verdict and the correct number. Build support triples from a shared public bank offered to every arm; the private calibration triples must not leak into feature rankings. Use matched neutral/correct/incorrect-suggestion effects on both the verdict and the numerical answer, then verify that permanent edits improve fresh outputs with hooks removed. Native inspection permits at most 16 evaluated sequences; four triples use 12, leaving four evaluations for follow-up unless cached or budgets are extended. [2,5,6]
technical_features.edit_and_replay: Submission writes iwibench.replacements.v1 safetensors with pinned model and revision, dense replacements or sparse indices plus absolute replacement values. The service records SHA-256, changed-parameter count, norms and weight revision. The grading worker receives the patch in a new process and checks bytes and base identity before applying it. Persist the committed numeric patch and provenance; compare fresh-process native outputs and raw counts across adapters using the exact same artifact. [4,5,7]
technical_features.patch_quality: Native reward = max(0,(edited target success − base target success)/(1 − base target success)) × retention on originally correct controls, pooled over nearby, general and override groups. No-op earns zero. Report signed gain, correct-suggestion versus wrong-suggestion accuracy, both content and verdict, and the number of previously correct controls lost. On three published Sol-low resistance episodes, base was 98/192, edited was 145/192, and 328/328 previously correct controls were retained. Per-episode mean reward .4993. These historical edits are background context, not a concurrent treatment group. [2,6,8]
technical_features.updater_cost: In the upstream per-episode Sol-low resistance traces, cumulative input was 1,193,023 to 1,397,655 tokens, compared with 2,615–3,194 output tokens and 20–23 updater calls. For Astra over the same three episodes, 94.8–95.4% of input tokens were recorded as cached (computed from the upstream data). The full manifest is embedded in the first user message. Separately measure cached and fresh input, tool-result composition and replayed prefixes; profile paged manifest access independently of handle-only reads. Value-only payload microbenchmarks cannot predict whole-run savings. [4,9]
technical_features.target_cost: Native hard limits include 128 admitted calls, eight generation calls (64 sequence evaluations), four inspection calls (16 sequence evaluations), and 262,144 target forward tokens per episode. Base-vs-edited comparisons consume both evaluations. The three historical Sol-low resistance runs consumed only 1,874–1,975 target forward tokens in updater probes, separate from updater usage and evaluator costs. Charge actual prompt/continuation passes and SAE compute, warm/idle GPU time, and fresh verification separately. Pin operator, batch, dictionary and hardware before projecting cost per trial. [2,5,9]
technical_features.uncertainty: The hypothesis that interpretability improves edits and the live cost reduction remain [uncertain]. An earlier local Etude replication excluded resistance seeds 2,3,5 for exact pristine-count parity differences, while all were fresh-model eligible; measure the current pristine reference for each trial and separately label historical parity. Pair arms on the same calibrated seeds and aggregate repeated updater samples within episodes. Three pilot seeds estimate feasibility rather than population-wide performance. [10]
technical_features.portability_and_terms: Two native supported checkpoints are explicitly pinned: Gemma 3 1B IT and 4B IT. Data-card MIT coverage for code and original benchmark data is separate from third-party material, base weights and released Gemma-derived patch terms. The code pin does not contain a top-level LICENSE, so trace exact terms before copying or distributing. The data catalog is qualified for the 4B model; another checkpoint needs pristine recalibration. Hosted updater credentials, a local target worker and a trainer-driven updater have independent deployment requirements. [2,3,11]
technical_features.sequential_transfer: Published native episodes start from a clean pinned base for one objective. They support evidence of fresh-process generalization to held-out examples under that objective. A persistent-memory claim requires a controlled stream with cumulative numeric patches, fresh target contexts, intermediate and delayed scoring on older objectives, a baseline with retrieved or contextualized experience, and an audit of all state transferred across jobs. [1,2]
